ruleset.name: Sonar
ruleset.description: Implementing Sonar rules through PMD custom rules.

rule.name: SQLInjectionCheck

description.p: The parameter of String Type in ArgumentList of Sql-related Functions should be checked
This rule detects instances whether the parameter is using a bind mechanism like "ok"+para

rule.name: ForLoopIncrementSignCheck
rule.message: A for loop update clause should move the counter in the right direction

description.p: In ForLoopIncrement "i" is increasing while the condition of ForStatementExpression is in the form of i>N,so it will never reach "stop condition",vice versa.
This rule detects instances whether the increment of for loop is correct

rule.name: IgnoredStreamReturnValueCheck
rule.message: The value returned from a stream read should be checked

description.p: The return value of stream function read and skip should be checked
This rule detects instances whether the return value of directly or transitively using InputStream Function read and skip is checked
